question: Which of the following was the last five year plan of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Five-year plans** are development plans in India that are formulated by the government to achieve various socio-economic objectives over a period of five years.
 
• The **12th five-year plan was implemented from 2012-2017**, with the aim of achieving inclusive growth, enhancing social development, and promoting sustainable development.
 
 
• It was the **last five year plan in India.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian Planning Commission** was **established **in **1950 **to **formulate **and implement** five-year plans for economic development in India.**

 
 
• It was **replaced by NITI Aayog since January 1, 2015.**
 
• After the Planning Commission, the five year plans also stopped to be made in India.
